user_intent: 期望 亮度 处于 500 lux 到 740 lux
期望 温度 处于 27 ℃ 到 28 ℃
二氧化碳浓度 应 低于 16%
期望 声音 处于 45 dB
期望 湿度 处于 38 %
如果 人在家 那么 提高环境香味
如果发生火灾，那么开始报警
如果发生火灾，那么打开逃生通道
人离开时，关闭所有影音、照明、环境控制及厨电类电器
standard_taps: IF wotie_brightness_sensor.brightness() < 500 AND aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == true THEN brightness_up() wotie_brightness_sensor
IF wotie_brightness_sensor.brightness() > 740 AND aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == true THEN brightness_down() wotie_brightness_sensor
IF aqara_temperature_sensor.reading() > 28 AND aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == true THEN turn_cool_on() xiaomi_air_conditioner
IF aqara_temperature_sensor.reading() < 27 AND aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == true THEN turn_heat_on() xiaomi_air_conditioner
IF mijia_CO2_ultra_sensor.get_CO2_concentration() > 16 AND aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == true THEN turn_on() xiaomi_air_purifier
IF xiaomi_volume_sensor.reading() > 45 AND aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == true THEN set_volume_low() xiaomi_television
IF xiaomi_volume_sensor.reading() < 45 AND aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == true THEN set_volume_high() xiaomi_television
IF xiaomi_humidity_sensor.relative_humidity() < 38 AND aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == true THEN turn_on() zhimi_humidifier
IF xiaomi_humidity_sensor.relative_humidity() > 38 AND aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == true THEN turn_off() zhimi_humidifier
IF aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == true THEN turn_on() xiaomi_diffuser
IF yunmi_water_purifier.tds_in() <= 74 THEN filter_water() yunmi_water_purifier
IF aqara_smoke_sensor.reading() > 0.05 THEN turn_on() aqara_alarm
IF aqara_smoke_sensor.reading() > 0.05 THEN turn_on() chuangmi_door
IF aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == false THEN light_off() wotie_brightness_sensor
IF aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == false THEN turn_off() xiaomi_air_conditioner
IF aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == false THEN turn_off() xiaomi_air_purifier
IF aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == false THEN turn_off() xiaomi_television
IF aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == false THEN turn_off() zhimi_humidifier
IF aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == false THEN power_off() viomi_hood
IF aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == false THEN turn_off() xiaomi_diffuser
